title: xDrip+ stop pairing, won't send pair request, when using Fitbit versa lite
symptom: xDrip+ stops pairing with the Dexcom G6 transmitter and does not send a pairing request notification, even though the log says it did. The issue occurs when using a Fitbit Versa Lite watch with the Fitbit app installed. Uninstalling the Fitbit app resolves the issue temporarily, but it returns after reinstalling. The problem has been occurring intermittently for months.
cause: The thread suggests the issue is caused by interference from the Fitbit app, possibly related to how it intercepts Bluetooth pairing requests. However, the exact mechanism is not confirmed, and later comments indicate the issue may also occur without the Fitbit app, suggesting multiple causes.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. Workarounds include uninstalling the Fitbit app, disabling the smartwatch, restarting the phone, and updating to the latest Nightly version. The maintainer suggests that the issue is due to Fitbit app interference and that xDrip cannot fix it, recommending to keep xDrip updated and to use discussions for further help.
evidence_quote: This issue was rather about the interference caused by fitbit. And it looks like that is something to do with the fitbit app and not xDrip.
